ns2:course.label: Constructing Race in America
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary examination of the historical, cultural, and social dimensions of race and ethnicity in the United States. Explores the complex and intricate pursuit of multiracial and multicultural democracy. Same as AAS 281, AFRO 281, and LLS 281.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
